title: The Number of Good Subsets
goal: Count subsets whose product is a product of distinct primes.
strategy: Reject values containing squared prime factors. A prime-mask DP combines only disjoint factor sets; duplicate values multiply the choice count, and any subset of ones may accompany a nonempty prime product.
